overview_description.description: Through a combination of industry-leading AI, a marketplace of human transcriptionists, and over 6.5 millions of hours of real-world data, Rev is the most accurate transcription service on the market. Leading in price, speed and quality, Rev delivers compliant captions, transcriptions and subtitles in 75+ languages. The chosen speech-to-text partner for Vimeo, Spotify, Yale, PBS and Sundance Film Festival, Rev is progressing accessibility across industries and revolutionizing what it means to understand the human voice. Do more with every word at Rev.com.

product.name: Human Transcription
product.description: A service providing transcription of audio and video files by human transcribers with 99% accuracy, producing court-admissible transcripts.

product.name: AI Transcription
product.description: An automated speech-to-text service that transcribes audio and video files quickly with over 96% accuracy, producing court-admissible transcripts.

product.name: Human Captions
product.description: A service that creates accessible and compliant captions for video content using human transcribers.

product.name: Global Subtitles
product.description: A service providing accurate subtitles in 17 languages for video content to support global distribution.

product.name: AI Captions
product.description: An automated service that generates captions for video content in 38 languages using AI technology.

product.name: AI Templates
product.description: Tools that transform lengthy audio or video content into key points with linked timestamps for legal and research use.
